    BedrockExperiment
    Marks a component for which the Minecraft creator docs name an experiment toggle ("Upcoming Creator Features" and the like), in some format versions.
    BedrockFormat
    The minimum add-on JSON format_version the creator documentation names for a component or field.
    BedrockSince
    The first bundled data version (DataVersion#name(), e.g.
    BedrockUntil
    The first bundled release (DataVersion#name(), e.g.
    Education
    Marks Bedrock content that BDS only offers to worlds with Education Edition features: the generated vanilla constants of chemistry items, element blocks, hard glass and the like.
    Experimental
    Marks API that is public and supported, but not covered by the compatibility promise: it may change or be removed in a minor release without a deprecation cycle.
    Internal
    Marks a public type or member of an exported package that is not part of Paletter's API: it is public only so Paletter's own packages can share it.
    ReplacedBy
    Names the components that replace a deprecated one: Bedrock's documentation or Bedrock Dedicated Server itself says so (for example "Use minecraft:x instead").
    ServerOnly
    Marks a component that Bedrock Dedicated Server accepts in a pack but never sends to clients, in the protocols of the range.
    SincePreview
    Marks generated API that only the bundled Bedrock preview has: content or components that no bundled release has yet.
